// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the configuration.
Tenant* (xref:#entidad-tenant[Tenant])::
Tenant these settings apply to.
Display name (string)::
Name shown to the users of the tenant, for example on the sign-in screen.
Force mfa* (boolean)::
Requires every user of the tenant to sign in with a second factor.
Dynamic registration policy (TenantConfigDynamicRegistrationPolicyOptions)::
Who can register clients dynamically: anyone (open), only with an initial access token (token_required) or nobody (disabled).Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * open
 * token_required
 * disabled

Self registration enabled (boolean)::
Lets users create their own account from the sign-in screen.
Auto approve registered users (boolean)::
Self-registered users can sign in right away; otherwise they wait for an administrator to approve them.
Magic link enabled (boolean)::
Lets users sign in with a link sent by email, without password.
Require email verification* (boolean)::
If true, users must confirm their email address via the verification link before they can complete their first login. The OIDC flow will hold the user at a verification-pending challenge until the link is clicked.
Invitation expiry days* (integer)::
Number of days before an unused user invitation expires.
Magic link expiry minutes* (integer)::
Number of minutes before a magic-link token expires after being sent. Only relevant when magic-link-enabled=true.
Session sso ttl seconds* (integer)::
Lifetime in seconds of the cross-client SSO session cookie. After this duration the user must re-authenticate even if a per-flow session is still valid. Corresponds to the max_age upper bound for prompt=none requests.
Refresh token ttl seconds* (integer)::
Lifetime in seconds of issued refresh tokens. Defaults to 30 days (2 592 000 s). Applies to all grant types that issue refresh tokens for this tenant.
Refresh token max lifetime seconds* (integer)::
Absolute lifetime of a refresh token family; rotation never extends it.
Dcr allowed grant types (blob)::
JSON list of the grant types a dynamically registered client may request.
Dcr allowed auth methods (blob)::
JSON list of the token endpoint authentication methods a dynamically registered client may use.
Allow password grant* (boolean)::
Allows the resource owner password grant, in which the client receives the user credentials directly.
Require pushed authorization requests* (boolean)::
Requires every client of the tenant to send its authorization requests through PAR (RFC 9126).
Acr values supported (blob)::
JSON map of published ACR values to session level, e.g. {"urn:lugh:acr:pwd":1,"urn:lugh:acr:mfa":2}
Webauthn enabled (boolean)::
Lets users sign in with passkeys and security keys (WebAuthn).
Webauthn rp id (string)::
WebAuthn relying party identifier: the domain the passkeys are bound to.
Webauthn rp name (string)::
Name of the relying party shown by the browser when creating a passkey.
Welcome email template (blob)::
Email sent to a user when the account is enabled for the first time.
Registered email template (blob)::
Email sent when a user registers.
Disabled user email template (blob)::
Email sent when a user is disabled.
Enabled user email template (blob)::
Email sent when a user is enabled.
Password recovery enabled (boolean)::
Lets users reset a forgotten password by email.
Recover pass email template (blob)::
Email sent to the user to recover the password.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de tenant config para controlar bloqueos optimistas
